A '''[[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]''', along with a fellow [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]], commanded a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] departed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] with captured Separatist [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], escorted by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], aboard and attained clearance to land on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']].<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />
